This template is used to date the events of various Dynamic Encounters in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', per [[Forum:CT:Dating future SWTOR story and Dynamic Encounters]]. For Dynamic Encounters whose events conflict with the planet's dates, the <code>reason</code> and <code>year</code> parameters must be given.

:<code><nowiki>{{DynamicDate|Radio Silencing|Tatooine}}</nowiki></code>
Results in:
:{{DynamicDate|Radio Silencing|Tatooine}}

:<code><nowiki>{{DynamicDate|title=Insert Name Here|year=no earlier than [[3636 BBY]]|reason=[[Darth Xarion]] is mentioned as being a member of the [[Dark Council]], and Xarion was not a councilor before the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]}}</nowiki></code>
Result in:
:{{DynamicDate|title=Insert Name Here|year=no earlier than [[3636 BBY]]|reason=[[Darth Xarion]] is mentioned as being a member of the [[Dark Council]], and Xarion was not a councilor before the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]}}
